pages.text: The $(d)Dragon Breath$() Gene lets players shoot a Dragon Fireball with its keybind, which is unset by default.$(br2)This has a configurable cooldown, with the default being 15 seconds.$(br2)This Gene $(c)cannot be given to mobs$().
These are the default chances. Modpacks may change them.$(br2)6/11 - Ender Dragon
